# Where to Watch Home Run


by Angel | September 1, 2026


What happens when the biggest battle isn’t on the baseball field?


After alcohol-related incidents derail his career, a once-successful baseball player is forced to return to his hometown and enter a recovery program. It’s a long way from the life he thought he’d have—and exactly where he needs to be.


[Stream Home Run today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/home-run)


### **What Is** ***Home Run*** **About?**


*Home Run* follows a fallen baseball star whose drinking has cost him his career and damaged the relationships closest to him. Returning home and entering recovery forces him to confront more than his addiction. He must reckon with the pain and patterns that shaped him—and decide whether he’s willing to break them.


Coaching Little League gives him an unexpected opportunity to look beyond himself. The team may need him to show up, but he discovers that showing up for others can also help him find his way back to himself.


It’s a story about addiction and recovery, but it’s also about family, forgiveness, accountability, and what it means to start over when life doesn’t look anything like you planned.


### **A Story About More Than Recovery**


One of the things that makes *Home Run* resonate is its willingness to take addiction seriously without losing sight of hope. The story doesn’t pretend healing is simple or that one decision can erase years of hurt.


Instead, it explores the messy, difficult process of facing the truth and learning to live differently.


Angel Guild members have praised the film for its honest portrayal of addiction and its message of redemption. One viewer called it “a wonderful story about redemption and breaking the cycle of abuse and addiction,” while another said the film was “rare” in how well it portrayed the struggle with addiction.


And at the center of it all is a powerful reminder: success isn’t always measured by what you accomplish. Sometimes, the biggest victory is having the courage to face your past, make things right, and take the next step forward.


### **Where to Watch** ***Home Run***


If you’re looking for a heartfelt story about recovery, family, and second chances, *Home Run* is worth adding to your watchlist. Whether addiction has touched your family personally or you simply want a story about finding hope after losing your way, this is a film that has something to say.
